title: Good Values
description: Kindness, respect, honesty, and helping others.

levels.title: Sharing is Caring
levels.lessonText: When we share, everyone feels happy. Share your toys and snacks.
levels.prompt: Your friend has no pencil. What is the kind choice?

levels.title: Saying Please and Thank You
levels.lessonText: Good manners make people feel respected. Say please and thank you.
levels.prompt: Your teacher gives you a book. What do you say?

levels.title: Listening When Others Speak
levels.lessonText: Listening shows respect. Look at the speaker and wait your turn.
levels.prompt: Your classmate is telling a story. What should you do?

levels.title: Telling the Truth
levels.lessonText: Honesty builds trust. Tell the truth even when it is hard.
levels.prompt: You broke a cup by accident. What is the honest choice?

levels.title: Helping at Home
levels.lessonText: Helping your family shows love. Do small chores with a happy heart.
levels.prompt: Your mother is carrying a heavy bag. What can you do?

levels.title: Taking Care of Our Things
levels.lessonText: We care for our belongings and our classroom. Put things back.
levels.prompt: You finished reading a book. What should you do?

levels.title: Values in Action: In Class
levels.lessonText: In class, we are kind, respectful, and ready to learn.
levels.prompt: A classmate cannot solve a problem. What do you do?

levels.title: Values in Action: At Home
levels.lessonText: At home, we show love and respect to our family.
levels.prompt: Your little sister wants to play. What is the kind choice?

levels.title: Values in Action: In Our Community
levels.lessonText: In our community, we care for people and places.
levels.prompt: You see trash on the playground. What is the responsible choice?

levels.title: Good Values Celebration
levels.lessonText: You have learned many good values. Keep practicing them every day.
levels.prompt: Which value means telling the truth?
